description: A React component implementing a two-panel authentication UI with email/password sign-in and sign-up functionality, integrated with Supabase for backend authentication.

methods.name: validateEmail
methods.description: Validates email format, returns error message or null.

methods.name: validatePassword
methods.description: Validates password length, returns error message or null.

methods.name: formatAuthError
methods.description: Converts AuthError objects into user-friendly messages.

methods.name: AuthTwoPanel
methods.description: Main React functional component for authentication interface with mode switching, form handling, and UI elements.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for login or signup, invoking Supabase auth methods.
